title: Owner: a wave's exit 6 for unneeded declared files counts as meeting the exit criterion
context: Wave 1 ended with every Lane ok, gates of 34 of 34 and 2 of 2 passing, and no undeclared or foreign writes. Its exit code was 6 only because reconcile listed declared test files that Steps did not need to change. Criterion 1 asked for exit 0.
options: Count it as met and reword the criterion
outcome: The owner chose "Count it as met". Criteria 1 and 2 are reworded: every Lane ok, every gate verdict pass, and no reconcile finding other than declared-but-unwritten paths. Criterion 1 is marked met with the wave 1 evidence, and wave 2 is judged the same way.
